task: Gate Cost Centers, Budget Management, and Chargeback feature flags on codemie-enterprise package presence by mirroring the existing enterpriseEdition runtime-computed-component pattern.

key_reasoning.reason: The shared CustomerConfig runtime-flag mechanism is the central touch point, but the change ripples through CostCenterService, ProjectService's chargeback path, budget services/routers (a new enforcement point that doesn't exist today), and the UI feature-flag wrapper layer, spanning both the codemie and codemie-ui repositories.

Real design decisions remain open: whether budgetManagement has any backend enforcement point today (research found none), whether the Cost Centers UI gap self-resolves once the backend flag is corrected or needs an explicit UI composition fix, and two prior stories that deliberately deferred related gating decisions and may be revisited here.

The exact mechanism already exists for enterpriseEdition with direct unit-test precedent to model from, but this closes a real enforcement gap for Budget Management (no confirmed server-side gate exists) and changes default-enabled semantics for absent YAML keys — a licensing/access-control gap-closing change, which triggers the Security/Compliance red flag.

Expected changes span customer_config.py plus its test suite, a new (extent-unconfirmed) enforcement addition for budget routers/services, and UI-side tabs.tsx/feature-flag-wrapper updates plus tests — likely in the 8-10 modified / few new file range across 3+ directories in two repositories.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: closing a licensing/access-control enforcement gap (enterprise-only features reachable without the enterprise package) — Security/Compliance red flag.
